    potential = {
        exists = from
        from = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s4_mapped }
    }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        from = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s4_job_agri_drone }

            if = {

                }
                else = {
                    set_country_flag = bca_jr_disable_alien_hunter
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s4_job_archivist }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_disable_archivist }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_disable_archivist
                }
                else = {
                    set_country_flag = bca_jr_disable_archivist
                }
            }
            if = {

                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_disable_ark_harvester }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_disable_ark_harvester

bca_jr_toggle_global = {
    potential = { exists = from }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        from = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_enabled }
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_enabled
            }
            else = {
                set_country_flag = bca_jr_enabled
            }
        }
    }
}
